scenario: Session restarted after compaction. Reload the persisted task state and the post-install adaptation state from .pixz/, re-establish active capabilities and continue from next_action without redoing setup.
setup: .pixz/task-state.json (active task) and .pixz/adaptation-state.json (ready) exist on disk; conversation context is gone.
expected_behavior: E8 persistence: learning survives the session boundary — state is read from disk first, objective restated, next_action honored, ready adaptation honored (no re-setup), active capabilities re-established from state.
failure_condition: Agent re-derives state from memory, re-runs post-install setup, or loses the ready adaptation across the boundary.
verification: lifecycle.persisted-reload passes in a fresh process; resume follows task-state resume protocol; adaptation probe exit 0.
verifies: self-learning survives compaction/restart via the file substrate (mission E8, §13)
